**[English](#english) | [简体中文](#chinese)**

**v1.2.1 — Maintenance pass (no behavior change)**
- All Java comments unified to Chinese (previously mixed EN/ZH).
- Deduplicated the 2^28 wrap period: single source in `SectionEncoding#WRAP_PERIOD` (was defined twice, in `WorldGenRegionMixin` and `StaticCache2DMixin`).
- Flattened `WorldGenRegion#wrapChunkRequest`: static offset array + extracted `lookupWrappedChunk` helper, loop nesting down to 3 levels.
- `FarLandsProbeConfig`: every toggle now documents its feature → mixin mapping, so the README is no longer the only index of what each option controls.

**v1.2.1 — 维护性清理（无行为变更）**
- 全部 Java 注释统一为中文（原中英混杂）。
- 回绕周期 2^28 去重：统一到 `SectionEncoding#WRAP_PERIOD`（原在 `WorldGenRegionMixin`/`StaticCache2DMixin` 各定义一份）。
- `WorldGenRegion#wrapChunkRequest` 降嵌套：偏移数组静态化 + 提取 `lookupWrappedChunk` 辅助方法，循环嵌套降到 3 层。
- `FarLandsProbeConfig`：每个开关补充「功能 → mixin」映射注释，README 不再是理解功能全貌的唯一索引。

## Downloads

- **MC 26.2**: `farlandsprobe-26.2-1.2.1.jar`
- **MC 26.1.2**: `farlandsprobe-26.1.2-1.2.1.jar`

Requires Fabric Loader ≥ 0.19.3 and [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) (required); Mod Menu is optional.

releases.notes:
## What's new
**Multi-version support**: FarLandsProbe now builds for **Minecraft 26.2** and **Minecraft 26.1.2** from a single shared source tree. Every mixin target is API-identical between the two versions, so there is zero source divergence.

- Twin-project build: root = 26.2, `mc-26.1.2` subproject = 26.1.2
- `./gradlew build` produces both jars in one run
- fabric.mod.json now pins the exact game version per jar

## Jars
- `farlandsprobe-26.2-1.2.0.jar` — Minecraft 26.2
- `farlandsprobe-26.1.2-1.2.0.jar` — Minecraft 26.1.2

Requires Fabric Loader ≥ 0.19.3 and [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) (required); Mod Menu optional.

> ⚠️ For exploration only — worlds past the packing limits will be damaged unpredictably. Do not use on important saves.

releases.notes: **[English](#english) | [简体中文](#chinese)** ## English **v1.1.2** — far-edge stability restored + codebase cleanup. ### Changes - **Restored the far-edge stability patches**: wrap-aware worldgen distance/cache (`WorldGenRegion`/`StaticCache2D`), edge feature-skip, pathfinding-skip and the aquifer int-edge guard. Generating near or past the int32 edge **no longer OOMs or freezes**. - **No coordinate wrap-around**: past ±2,147,483,647 terrain simply stops generating and the game stays responsive (no folding). - **Mineshafts generate again**: removed the global disable datapack; the overflow-safe midpoint patch covers far coordinates. - **HMAP-driven cleanup**: fullbright centralized, 11 unit tests, magic numbers documented, `.editorconfig` added, support classes moved out of the mixin package (fixed a worldgen crash). ### Features (all optional toggles) - Fullbright (max light everywhere) - Remove world border + the three invisible walls - Relax spawn/teleport checks; allow chunk generation everywhere - Extend section encoding (28/8/28, auto-off under C2ME) - Fix chunk generation at the int edge - Far-lands stability patches (huge move deltas, entity/lighting/mineshaft/aquifer/octree overflow, structure skip) ### Dependencies - **Cloth Config** (required): https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config - **Mod Menu** (optional): open config from the mod list - ⚠️ Changing settings requires a game restart --- ## 中文 **v1.1.2** — 恢复边界稳定性修复 + 代码清理。 ### 变更 - **恢复边界稳定性修复**：回绕感知的世界生成距离/缓存（`WorldGenRegion`/`StaticCache2D`）、边界 feature 跳过、寻路跳过、aquifer int 边界防御。接近/越过 int32 边界生成时**不再 OOM 或卡死**。 - **没有坐标回绕**：越过 ±2,147,483,647 后地形停止生成，游戏保持响应（不折叠）。 - **矿井恢复生成**：删除全局禁用数据包；溢出安全中点补丁覆盖远地坐标。 - **HMAP 驱动的清理**：fullbright 集中化、11 个单元测试、魔法数字补注释、新增 `.editorconfig`、support 类移出 mixin 包（修复一个世界生成崩溃）。 ### 功能（全部可独立开关） - 无黑暗（全局最高亮度） - 移除世界边境 + 三道隐形墙 - 放开生成/传送检查；允许任意坐标生成区块 - 扩展区块坐标编码（28/8/28，C2ME 下自动关闭） - 修复 int 边界区块生成 - 远地稳定性修复（超大移动增量、实体/光照/矿井/aquifer/八叉树溢出、结构跳过） ### 依赖 - **Cloth Config**（必装）：https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config - **Mod Menu**（可选）：从模组列表打开配置 - ⚠️ 修改配置后需要重启游戏

releases.notes: **[English](#english) | [简体中文](#chinese)** ## English **v1.1.1** — cleanup release. ### Changes - **Reverted the Y-axis experiment**: section encoding is back to **X/Z 28 bits + Y 8 bits** (X/Z reach the int32 edge ±2,147,483,632 blocks; Y stays at the world-height range). - **Removed all code that tried to generate chunks beyond the 32-bit limit**: coordinate wrap-around, edge-chunk worldgen hacks (WorldGenRegion/StaticCache2D), edge feature-skip and pathfinding-skip. - **±2,147,483,647 is the hard end**: past it coordinates wrap in `int` and terrain does not generate — that is the physical limit (BlockPos is a 32-bit int; arbitrary precision would require a whole game fork). - **C2ME auto-compat retained** (falls back to vanilla encoding when C2ME is detected). ### Features (all optional toggles) - Fullbright (max light everywhere) - Remove world border + the three invisible walls - Relax spawn/teleport checks; allow chunk generation everywhere - Extend section encoding (28/8/28, auto-off under C2ME) - Far-lands stability patches (huge move deltas, entity/lighting/mineshaft/aquifer/octree overflow, structure skip) ### Dependencies - **Cloth Config** (required): https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config - **Mod Menu** (optional): open config from the mod list - ⚠️ Changing settings requires a game restart --- ## 中文 **v1.1.1** — 清理版。 ### 变更 - **撤销 Y 轴扩展实验**：坐标编码恢复为 **X/Z 28 位 + Y 8 位**（X/Z 可达 int32 极限 ±2,147,483,632 格；Y 保持世界高度范围）。 - **删除所有试图在 32 位上限之外生成区块的代码**：坐标回绕、边界区块生成 hack（WorldGenRegion/StaticCache2D）、边界 feature 跳过、寻路跳过。 - **±2,147,483,647 是硬终点**：越过之后坐标在 `int` 里回绕，地形无法生成——这是物理上限（BlockPos 是 32 位 int；任意精度需要整套游戏 fork）。 - **保留 C2ME 自动兼容**（检测到 C2ME 时回落到 vanilla 编码）。 ### 功能（全部可独立开关） - 无黑暗（全局最高亮度） - 移除世界边境 + 三道隐形墙 - 放开生成/传送检查；允许任意坐标生成区块 - 扩展区块坐标编码（28/8/28，C2ME 下自动关闭） - 远地稳定性修复（超大移动增量、实体/光照/矿井/aquifer/八叉树溢出、结构跳过） ### 依赖 - **Cloth Config**（必装）：https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config - **Mod Menu**（可选）：从模组列表打开配置 - ⚠️ 修改配置后需要重启游戏

releases.notes: **[English](#english) | [简体中文](#chinese)** ## English **v1.1.0** — Minecraft **26.2** Fabric mod for exploring precision corruption past the world edge. > ⚠️ This mod does **NOT** restore the Far Lands. It removes the modern world border & coordinate limits so you can observe the breakdown. ### New in 1.1.0 - **C²M (C2ME) compatibility**: when C2ME is detected, the 28/8/28 section encoding auto-falls back to vanilla (C2ME is incompatible with extended packing). Use a non-C2ME environment for full far-lands exploration. - **Beyond the 32-bit limit**: past ±2,147,483,647 the world **folds** (coordinates wrap by 2³²). The terrain you see is still generated by the 32-bit generator at the wrapped coordinates — not genuinely new 32-bit+ terrain. - **Rendering caveat**: near/over the edge you may see **chunk flashing/flicker, sections popping, light flicker, blocks briefly disappearing** — expected at the int limit. - **Stability patches**: Aquifer OOM guard, wrap-aware worldgen distance/cache, edge chunk feature-skip, pathfinding skip past ±2×10⁹, huge move delta guard, etc. ### Features (all optional toggles) - Fullbright (max light everywhere) - Remove world border + the three invisible walls (Player.tick / clampHorizontal / absSnapTo) - Relax spawn/teleport checks; allow chunk generation everywhere - Extend section encoding (28/8/28, auto-off under C2ME) - Wrap coordinates past the int limit - Fix chunk generation at the int edge - Far-lands stability patches (entity/lighting/mineshaft/aquifer/octree overflow, structure skip) ### Configuration - `config/farlandsprobe.json` (auto-generated; all toggles default **on**) - Config screen via **Cloth Config** (required); **Mod Menu** optional - ⚠️ Changing settings requires a game restart ### Dependencies - **Cloth Config** (required): https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config - **Mod Menu** (optional): open config from the mod list > Disclaimer: terrain/worlds will be damaged unpredictably past the packing limits. Exploration only. --- ## 中文 **v1.1.0** — Minecraft **26.2** Fabric 模组，用于探索世界边界之外、精度开始崩坏的地形。 > ⚠️ 本 mod 并非「恢复边境之地（Far Lands）」。它移除现代版本的世界边境与坐标限制，让你直接观察崩坏。 ### 1.1.0 更新 - **C²M（C2ME）兼容**：检测到 C2ME 时，28/8/28 坐标编码自动回落到 vanilla（C2ME 与扩展编码不兼容）。要看完整 far lands，请用无 C2ME 环境。 - **越过 32 位极限**：超过 ±2,147,483,647 后世界**折叠**（坐标回绕 2³²）。你看到的地形仍然是 32 位生成器在回绕后的坐标处生成的——不是真正超出 32 位的全新地形。 - **渲染提示**：边界附近/之外可能出现**区块闪烁、区块忽隐忽现、光照闪烁、方块短暂消失**——这是 int 极限下的预期现象。 - **稳定性修复**：Aquifer OOM 防御、回绕感知的世界生成距离/缓存、边界区块跳过 feature、超过 ±20 亿格跳过寻路、超大移动增量防护等。 ### 功能（全部可独立开关） - 无黑暗（全局最高亮度） - 移除世界边境 + 三道隐形墙（Player.tick / clampHorizontal / absSnapTo） - 放开生成/传送检查；允许任意坐标生成区块 - 扩展区块坐标编码（28/8/28，C2ME 下自动关闭） - 越过 int 极限时坐标回绕 - 修复 int 边界区块生成 - 远地稳定性修复（实体/光照/矿井/aquifer/八叉树溢出、结构跳过） ### 配置 - `config/farlandsprobe.json`（启动自动生成，全部默认开启） - 配置界面由 **Cloth Config** 提供（必装）；**Mod Menu** 可选 - ⚠️ 修改配置后需要重启游戏 ### 依赖 - **Cloth Config**（必装）：https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config - **Mod Menu**（可选）：从模组列表打开配置 > 免责声明：越过打包上限后地形/存档会以不可预期方式损坏，仅供探索使用。
